definitions.explanation: To forcefully expel saliva from the mouth. Considered rude behavior in public.

definitions.gloss: to speak abusively; to hurl insults
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to say something hateful or contemptuous.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}で{唾|つば}を{吐|は}くのはマナー{違反|いはん}だ。
examples.english: Spitting on the street is bad manners.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{地面|じめん}に{唾|つば}を{吐|は}いてから{歩|ある}き{去|さ}った。
examples.english: He spat on the ground and walked away.

examples.japanese: {公共|こうきょう}の{場|ば}で{唾|つば}を{吐|は}く{行為|こうい}は、{条例|じょうれい}で{禁止|きんし}されている{地域|ちいき}もある。
examples.english: In some areas, the act of spitting in public places is prohibited by local ordinance.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{怒|いか}りに{任|まか}せて{暴言|ぼうげん}を{吐|は}いた。
examples.english: She hurled abusive words in a fit of anger.

examples.japanese: {悪態|あくたい}を{吐|は}いても{何|なに}も{解決|かいけつ}しない。
{負|ま}けた{悔|くや}しさから{捨|す}て{台詞|ぜりふ}を{吐|は}いて{去|さ}っていった。
examples.english: Out of frustration from losing, he spat out a parting shot and left.

notes:
The literal meaning is to spit saliva ({唾|つば}). The verb {吐|は}く extends figuratively to spitting out words — saying something harsh or contemptuous. In the figurative sense, the object changes from {唾|つば} to words like {暴言|ぼうげん} (abusive language) or {悪態|あくたい} (insults).

The related expression {天|てん}に{唾|つば}する (to spit at heaven) is a proverb meaning that insults directed at others will come back to harm oneself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道|みち}に{唾|つば}を{吐|は}く: to spit on the road
- {暴言|ぼうげん}を{吐|は}く: to hurl abusive language
- {悪態|あくたい}を{吐|は}く: to hurl insults
- {弱音|よわね}を{吐|は}く: to complain, to show weakness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {痰|たん}を{吐|は}く: to spit phlegm — specifically expelling phlegm
- {吐|は}き{捨|す}てる: to spit out, to say dismissively — emphasizes contempt in the way something is said
- {毒|どく}を{吐|は}く: to make venomous remarks — to say something deliberately hurtful
